metadata.notes: Authored by hand from the Results text, not an LLM extraction run. The paper describes each group explicitly in one paragraph, so no inference was needed.

1a.name: Early carbon-metabolism response
1a.functional_description: Carbon fixation and carboxysome genes -- rbcL, the RuBisCO small subunit, the carboxysome shell protein and the carbon dioxide-concentrating protein CcmK -- plus peroxiredoxin and three uncharacterised proteins.
1a.expression_dynamics: Rises by the first sampling point (15 min) and stays elevated through the early infection period.
1a.confidence_notes: Group membership and functional label are stated directly in the Results.

supporting_quotes.quote: Group 1a consisted of nine genes, such as ccmK, rbcL, rbcS, and csoS, which were immediately upregulated after phage addition and appear to be associated with carbon metabolism.

1b.name: Ribosomal protein response
1b.functional_description: Ribosomal proteins -- 30S subunit proteins S3, S4, S5, S8, S17 and 50S subunit proteins L1, L2, L3, L4, L5, L6, L7/L12, L10, L14, L15, L16, L18, L22, L23, L24.
1b.expression_dynamics: Lags Group 1a; together the two form the early-infection response.
1b.confidence_notes: Every member of this group is an annotated ribosomal protein, consistent with the paper's description.

supporting_quotes.quote: Genes of group 1b code for ribosomal proteins and were upregulated within 1-3 h after phage addition. Together, groups 1a and 1b consist of genes that were upregulated during the early period of infection.

2.name: Late SOS / stress response
2.functional_description: SOS-response genes umuC and umuD (annotated in the source table as a nucleotidyltransferase and an SOS-regulated protein) plus one uncharacterised protein; putatively a stress response.
2.temporal_pattern: Upregulated late in infection, 5-7 h after phage addition
2.expression_dynamics: No early induction; rises only in the late period, shortly before the 8 h latent-period end.
2.confidence_notes: The paper names umuC and umuD; the source table's annotations correspond to those products.

supporting_quotes.quote: Group 2 contains three genes, including umuC, umuD, and one unknown gene, that were upregulated during the late period of infection (5-7 h after phage addition) and putatively associated with stress responses.
